metadata.ringOrientation: RFC 7946 outer counterclockwise / holes clockwise; source ring order may be reversed, with every original coordinate retained.
metadata.geometryScope: Present-day OSM database extract at acquisition; not surveyed geometry, not a historical reconstruction. Whole source ways retained without clipping; use metadata.bbox for display clipping. No invented coordinates, building heights or missing relation members.
metadata.expandedScope: Expanded image/DSM window; only the Qingzang railway source-node chain is extended. Other OSM geometry retains its original acquisition scope.
